added_failures_note: Derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs over the reviewed run's own arms: gate/baseline.log (revision 70c2026ce3f4745b42718f6f68f0a0630bd016ae, scratch tree, 6 passed, EXIT=0) and observer-head-gate/after.log (revision 9741737502a49caed1aef3892e666ec0960c28f2, 38 passed, EXIT=0), so the head adds no failing test and the count is a measured 0 rather than an unmeasured one.

findings.text: _RowAugmentation.flux_delta passes unknowns[row_slice] to pair.unknown.flux_delta and ignores pair.binding.payload, so an inactive circuit compensator still contributes its image and tangent on the reduced route; the file is in the node's declared write paths, the fix at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:2099 does not reach it, and the goal's 'any proposal route' therefore holds only for the four routes the done_when enumerates.

both values of the shadowed parameter pass jnp.zeros_like(state, dtype=bool) to system.shadowed_map_fn, and the shadow branch at nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:2091-2097 selects base_shadowed_map only for a False mask, so the two arms are the same map; 16 parametrisations are 8 distinct cases and the claim of 'both live and frozen-shadow maps' at docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-inactive-compensator-recovery.html:6 is unsupported.

arm() re-implements the arm runner owned at scripts/prototypes/diiid_core_hold/regressions.py:21 (same revision header, EXIT line, FAILED/ERROR extraction and completed flag) instead of importing it, which is what scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_held_nodes/gates.py:21 does with the same owner.

the 16-failure unmasked reproduction is cited from a log the same paragraph says was overwritten, and the durable control at scripts/prototypes/diiid_inactive_compensator/gate.py:126 asserts that every failing id contains 'radial', so the circuit-source half of the guard has no recorded red run.
